summary.one_liner: A curated, multilingual list of links to free programming books, online courses, cheat sheets, podcasts, interactive tutorials, and practice problem sets, maintained on GitHub by the Free Ebook Foundation.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome"-style link collection rather than software. The README describes a list of free learning resources grouped by genre: Books (English by programming language, English by subject, and many other languages), Cheat Sheets, Free Online Courses, Interactive Programming Resources, Problem Sets and Competitive Programming, Podcasts and Screencasts, and Programming Playgrounds. Most sections are further split by language, with entries labeled in English, Chinese, Spanish, Russian, and dozens of other languages. The README includes a search link and a website version of the list, and it also points to translated contributing and code-of-conduct documents. The list grew from a StackOverflow list and was moved to GitHub for collaborative updates. The README does not itemize individual resources, so specific titles are not described here.
use_cases: Finding free programming books by language or subject
Locating free online programming courses in a non-English language
Finding practice problems for competitive programming
Discovering free programming podcasts and screencasts
Trying code in an online programming playground
notable: Organized by resource type and then by many spoken languages, with over 50 language variants for books
Maintained by the Free Ebook Foundation, a not-for-profit
Started as a StackOverflow list and moved to GitHub for community updates
Includes a searchable website version of the list
Covers books, courses, cheat sheets, podcasts, playgrounds, and problem sets in one place
caveats: It is a link list, so the linked resources are not hosted or checked in the repository itself
Many sections cover only a few languages; coverage varies by language
Translations of the contributing and code-of-conduct documents are incomplete, as the README notes
